## 1. Image

Pull, build, tag and push images. Everything else consumes an image reference.

| Type | Kind | Description | Skill reference | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `docker_image` | resource | A Docker image on the provider's daemon. | [reference/docker_image.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_image.md) | [resources/image.md](docs/resources/image.md) |
| `docker_registry_image` | resource | Pushes an image that exists on the provider's daemon (typically a `docker_image`) to its registry, using the provider's `registry_auth` credentials. | [reference/docker_registry_image.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_registry_image.md) | [resources/registry_image.md](docs/resources/registry_image.md) |
| `docker_tag` | resource | Adds a tag to an image already on the provider's daemon, like `docker tag SOURCE TARGET`. | [reference/docker_tag.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_tag.md) | [resources/tag.md](docs/resources/tag.md) |

## 2. Single-host primitives

Networks, volumes, plugins and plain containers on the daemon the provider points at.

| Type | Kind | Description | Skill reference | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docker_compose` | resource | A Docker Compose project applied through the Engine API, with no compose CLI plugin involved. | [reference/docker_compose.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_compose.md) | [resources/compose.md](docs/resources/compose.md) |
| `docker_container` | resource | A single-host Docker container, created with `ContainerCreate`, attached to its networks and started. | [reference/docker_container.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_container.md) | [resources/container.md](docs/resources/container.md) |
| `docker_network` | resource | A Docker network (`NetworkCreate`): a local `bridge`/`macvlan`/`ipvlan` network, or a Swarm-scoped `overlay` network when the daemon is a Swarm manager. | [reference/docker_network.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_network.md) | [resources/network.md](docs/resources/network.md) |
| `docker_plugin` | resource | A managed Docker Engine plugin installed from a registry, like `docker plugin install`. | [reference/docker_plugin.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_plugin.md) | [resources/plugin.md](docs/resources/plugin.md) |

## 3. Swarm topology

Turn the provider's daemon into a Swarm manager and join further hosts as workers or managers.

| Type | Kind | Description | Skill reference | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docker_swarm_init` | resource | Initializes a Docker Swarm on the provider's Docker host (`docker swarm init` through the Engine API), making that daemon the first manager. | [reference/docker_swarm_init.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_swarm_init.md) | [resources/swarm_init.md](docs/resources/swarm_init.md) |
| `docker_swarm_node` | resource | Joins a Docker host to an existing swarm. | [reference/docker_swarm_node.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_swarm_node.md) | [resources/swarm_node.md](docs/resources/swarm_node.md) |
| `data.docker_node` | data source | Looks up one swarm node through the provider's Docker host (which must be a manager), by `id` (full ID or unique prefix) or `hostname`. | [reference/data.docker_node.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_node.md) | [data-sources/node.md](docs/data-sources/node.md) |
| `data.docker_nodes` | data source | Lists the swarm's nodes through the provider's Docker host (which must be a manager), sorted by hostname, optionally filtered by `role`. | [reference/data.docker_nodes.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_nodes.md) | [data-sources/nodes.md](docs/data-sources/nodes.md) |
| `data.docker_swarm_tokens` | data source | Reads the join tokens of the swarm the provider's Docker host manages (SwarmInspect). | [reference/data.docker_swarm_tokens.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/data.docker_swarm_tokens.md) | [data-sources/swarm_tokens.md](docs/data-sources/swarm_tokens.md) |
| `ephemeral.docker_swarm_tokens` | ephemeral resource | Reads the worker and manager join tokens of the swarm the provider's Docker host manages, as ephemeral values that are never written to plan or state. | [reference/ephemeral.docker_swarm_tokens.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/ephemeral.docker_swarm_tokens.md) | [ephemeral-resources/swarm_tokens.md](docs/ephemeral-resources/swarm_tokens.md) |
| `list.docker_swarm_node` | list resource | Lists the swarm's nodes as `docker_swarm_node` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/list.docker_swarm_node.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/list.docker_swarm_node.md) | [list-resources/swarm_node.md](docs/list-resources/swarm_node.md) |

## 4. Swarm workload

Secrets, configs, services and stacks scheduled by the Swarm. Needs layer 3.

| Type | Kind | Description | Skill reference | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docker_config` | resource | A Swarm config: an immutable, non-secret blob mounted into service tasks as a file. | [reference/docker_config.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_config.md) | [resources/config.md](docs/resources/config.md) |
| `docker_secret` | resource | A Swarm secret: an immutable blob the Swarm managers store encrypted and mount into service tasks under `/run/secrets/<file_name>`. | [reference/docker_secret.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_secret.md) | [resources/secret.md](docs/resources/secret.md) |
| `docker_service` | resource | A Swarm service: a desired number of tasks (containers) of one image scheduled across the Swarm. | [reference/docker_service.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_service.md) | [resources/service.md](docs/resources/service.md) |
| `docker_stack` | resource | A Swarm stack built from API primitives (not a compose file, no CLI): services, overlay networks, secrets and configs, each named `<stack>_<name>` and labelled `com.docker.stack.namespace=<stack>` so `docker stack ls/ps` show them. | [reference/docker_stack.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/docker_stack.md) | [resources/stack.md](docs/resources/stack.md) |
| `action.docker_service_scale` | action | Sets the replica count of a replicated swarm service, like `docker service scale`, and waits for the tasks. | [reference/action.docker_service_scale.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/action.docker_service_scale.md) | [actions/service_scale.md](docs/actions/service_scale.md) |
| `list.docker_config` | list resource | Lists swarm configs as `docker_config` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/list.docker_config.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/list.docker_config.md) | [list-resources/config.md](docs/list-resources/config.md) |
| `list.docker_secret` | list resource | Lists swarm secrets as `docker_secret` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/list.docker_secret.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/list.docker_secret.md) | [list-resources/secret.md](docs/list-resources/secret.md) |
| `list.docker_service` | list resource | Lists swarm services as `docker_service` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. | [reference/list.docker_service.md](.claude/skills/terraform-provider-docker/reference/list.docker_service.md) | [list-resources/service.md](docs/list-resources/service.md) |
